implementation: 原创SVG涡扇发动机纵向剖面；22片风扇、3级低压/6级高压压气机、静子、12喷嘴标记、1级高压/3级低压涡轮、同轴双转子和内外流道。共享可视油门、运动暂停、内外流隔离、五段滚动教学、手动选择/重置与纠错测验均实际可操作。
tests: HTTP 200 at exact final public subpath; meaningful visible page, 22 fan blades, 14 rotor rows, five chapters, 160 desktop particles.
Keyboard Home/End/ArrowRight synchronize all three throttles and both spool readouts; real projected blades move, pause freezes geometry, zero freezes blades and particles.
Bypass/core controls independently hide path and particle groups and synchronize all scenes.
All five manual stage selections highlight relevant geometry; reset restores defaults; real scrolling selects all five cutaway states.
Wrong and correct quiz choices provide mechanical explanations; keyboard Enter selects; retry clears feedback and restores focus.
Desktop after interactions: no horizontal overflow.
Reduced motion freezes continuous rotors while keyboard readouts, scroll states, toggles and quiz remain functional.
Offscreen hero scene does not update rotor geometry.
1440×900 requested desktop layout: no horizontal overflow.
Mobile after touch/quiz/throttle interactions: no horizontal overflow.
390×844 mobile: 80 particles; actual touch pause, flow isolation, stage selection and quiz; 73% lab throttle synchronizes hero.

visualEvidence.desktop: 已打开真实1200×900截图：暖白版面与深绿剖面形成清晰层次；标题、CTA、发动机和控件间距均衡，无裁切。
visualEvidence.mobile: 已打开真实390×844截图：导航换行、标题、按钮和控制区完整，无页面横向溢出；缩小的示意图文字由下方可读章节补充。
visualEvidence.preview: 已打开ensurePreview实际生成的1200×900首屏，内容与本作品一致；预览使用减少动态效果设置。

correctedIssue: 首轮发现重置后滚动事件覆盖概览选中态，已令重置返回概览位置；修复后完整浏览器检查通过。
limitations: 按本轮授权采用原生HTML/CSS/JavaScript与SVG静态适配；未使用指定Vite/React/TypeScript/Three.js、OrbitControls、RoomEnvironment、Fontsource或Lucide依赖。
发动机为原创简化投影教学示意，非真实CAD、可旋转3D模型、气动/热力/燃烧仿真；4.8与12.5 rad/s及约2.6:1仅为教学速度，暂停时读数仍为教学设定值。
原始公开需求未包含Pro专属布局与动画章节，未访问或复制付费资源；不宣称复刻未提供的设计。
